h1: Golf Cart Rentals at World Equestrian Center
lead: Need a golf cart for World Equestrian Center in Ocala? Masters Golf Cars has you covered. We rent golf carts to people who compete, watch, or work at WEC horse shows.

We have been helping horse people in Marion County for over 26 years. Our shop sits on US-441 in Belleview, about 15 minutes south of WEC. With more than 300 golf carts ready to go, we can handle events big or small.

sections.h2: Why WEC Exhibitors Choose Masters Golf Cars

p: Horse shows need lots of carts. We get it. Masters Golf Cars keeps more than 300 golf carts in stock. That means we can rent to one barn or to a whole event. We bring carts to you, set them up, and pick them up when you leave.
Tell us where you need your cart. The Grand Arena? The Equestrian Hotel? Your barn on the back side? Our drivers know their way around WEC. We drop off carts right where you want them.

cards.h: Gas-Powered Carts That Run All Day
p: Our carts run on gas. You do not have to charge them. Just add fuel and keep going. This works great for long show days at World Equestrian Center, from early morning warm-ups to late night events.

cards.h: Rent by the Day, Week, or Month
p: We make it easy. Rent for one day or many weeks. Just tell us your show dates. Book early for big WEC events so you get the carts you need.

intro: World Equestrian Center sits on 378 acres in Marion County, Florida. It is one of the biggest horse show spots in the world. The place has 19 show arenas, the famous Grand Arena, and space for over 2,000 horses.
WEC is located off US-27 near Ocala. The Equestrian Hotel on site has shops and restaurants. Horse shows run here all year long. People fly in from all over the country.
The grounds are huge. Walking takes too long. A golf cart helps you get from the hotel to your barn to the show ring and back. Masters Golf Cars makes it easy to rent one.

sections.h2: How to Rent Golf Carts for WEC

p: Fill out our form. Tell us your show dates and how many carts you need. Let us know where at WEC you want them dropped off.
We will call you back with prices. Book early for big shows. Carts go fast during the Winter Circuit and major events.
Our team drives your carts to World Equestrian Center. They come with gas and are ready to go. We drop them off before your event starts.
When your show ends, tell us. We come get the carts. You do not have to bring them back yourself.
